canonical_statement: For a nonempty bounded open subset U of finite-dimensional real Euclidean space and T > 0, every real-valued function continuous on closure(U) x [0,T], twice continuously differentiable in space and once continuously differentiable in time in U x (0,T], and satisfying u_t - Laplacian u <= 0 there, attains a value on the initial-plus-lateral parabolic boundary that dominates all its values on the closed cylinder.
domain_and_universes: n : Nat with 1 <= n; Euclidean n := EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n); U : Set (Euclidean n); T : Real; u : Euclidean n x Real -> Real; Prop in universe 0
ordered_binders: u : Euclidean n x Real -> Real
hypotheses: for every t in (0,T], the spatial slice is ContDiffOn Real 2 on U
for every x in U, the temporal slice is ContDiffOn Real 1 on (0,T]
for every x in U and t in (0,T], deriv_t u - Laplacian_x u <= 0
conclusion: There exists b on (closure U x {0}) union (frontier U x [0,T]) such that every z in closure U x [0,T] satisfies u z <= u b.

encoding_decisions.space: EuclideanSpace Real (Fin n), so mathlib's Laplacian instance is available
encoding_decisions.parabolic_boundary: (closure U x {0}) union (frontier U x Set.Icc 0 T)
encoding_decisions.interior_time_range: Set.Ioc 0 T, matching the standard Q_T convention U x (0,T]
encoding_decisions.maximum: an attained boundary witness dominating the closed cylinder, equivalent to equality of attained maxima once both maxima are packaged

killed: changed arbitrary positive finite dimension to dimension one
moved the boundary witness inside the universal cylinder-point binder
incorrectly included the terminal face closure U x {T} in the boundary

degenerate_cases: The target excludes n = 0, the empty spatial domain, T <= 0, and unbounded U. The terminal face over interior U is not boundary data. Weak, viscosity, distributional, variable-coefficient, manifold, strong-principle, and equality-classification variants remain excluded.
status_boundary: Statement-only evidence: the exact target, direct pointwise transport, mutations, and initial-face boundary fact elaborate in the pinned environment. No maximum-principle proof, anchor/source acceptance, audit completion, or theorem completion is claimed.
